title: What We Do
description: Four ways Bay Area Youth Conservation works in San Leandro, San Lorenzo, and nearby communities.

header.heading: Education, service, and local partnerships.
header.body: Four ways we work in San Leandro, San Lorenzo, and nearby communities.

workItems.heading: Workshops
workItems.body: We host community workshops every two months at San Leandro Library, with youth-friendly topics that make local environmental action easier to understand.

workItems.heading: Volunteer Opportunities
workItems.body: We connect students with conservation-minded service opportunities that support neighborhoods, outdoor spaces, and community awareness.

workItems.heading: Education Posts
workItems.body: Through short, accessible posts, we share climate facts, sustainability tips, and conservation ideas students can use in everyday life.

workItems.heading: Collaborations
workItems.body: We work with schools, clubs, libraries, and local groups to bring youth conservation projects and education to more people.

socialFeed.heading: A community feed, built for real-world action.
socialFeed.body: BAYC shares workshop announcements, recaps, and simple conservation education through Instagram-style posts that are easy for students to follow and share.
